figures.caption: Fig. 3: The architecture of our DAM-VLA. Given an RGB image observation and a task description, the model predicts a sequence of temporal actions. The process consists of three key components: 1) a vision-language model that encodes observation into visual, class and register tokens, and integrates visual tokens with a set of linguistic tokens, and produces the cognition and reasoning latents; 2) an action routing module that generates a weight and feeds it into the dynamic action model; 3) a dynamic action model that dynamically executes different action models by combining the low-level class token or register token from the vision model with the high-level cognition latent from the VLM to predict an action sequence.
